raw:
Challenge the **replacement installation downtime of 80 hours** first. It is an Olumi assumption, not a measured figure, and it directly represents your stated risk: lost output before the replacement is ready. Within one quarter, a materially longer commissioning or cutover could offset much of the assumed capacity and reliability gain.

Ask the supplier: **what is the credible end-to-end downtime, including commissioning, faults and contingency—not just installation?**

No model change or rerun has been made.
